title.en: Turn a sketch into a future building

summary.en: A minimal sketch-to-architecture prompt with a visual reference doing most of the work.
summary.zh: 主要依赖视觉参考的极简草图转建筑提示词。

model.evidence: The creator names GPT Image 2.5 in the source post; the repository has not independently verified the output model.

steps.en: turn it into a future building
steps.zh: 把它变成一座未来建筑

inputs.en: A sketch that supplies the building shape.

notes.en: The source post shows both the rough input and the building result.
notes.zh: 原帖同时展示了粗略输入与建筑结果。
